kevin (sec-eng): Heads-up — observed several service-account SSO logins where JIT role resolution returned 0 roles. Pattern looks like username collision between a service-account and a regular user with the same localpart across tenants. Repro below, need quick mitigation.

maria (idp): Which IdP? Okta/ADFS? Can you paste a sample assertion (redact PII)?

kevin (sec-eng): Okta. Example assertion fragment (redacted):
```
<saml:Subject>
  <saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified\">svc-ops</saml:NameID>
</saml:Subject>
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name=\"email\"><saml:AttributeValue>svc-ops@acme.com</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name=\"tenant\"><saml:AttributeValue>acme</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
We're normalizing username to the localpart for service accounts (svc-ops) and then doing a global lookup which returns both svc-ops@acme and svc-ops@otherco -> ambiguous.

jonathan (sre): I pulled logs — auth-service:match_user_by_normalized_username returned 2 matches and code path falls into "ambiguous -> drop roles". Log lines:
```
2023-11-03T14:22:09Z auth-service INFO match_user_by_normalized_username svc-ops -> candidates=2
2023-11-03T14:22:09Z auth-service WARN ambiguous_lookup user=null assertion_id=XYZ
```

alex (platform): That's the v1 role-mapper behavior. Quick mitigation we can do now: flip config to tenant-qualified lookup for any assertion that includes tenant attribute. Hosted can flip with a config roll, private customers need patch.

maria (idp): This also creates an audit gap — current audit entry only records ambiguous match and user=null. We should record either the raw assertion (KMS-encrypted) or at minimum a fingerprint of assertion+tenant so investigations are possible without leaking PHI.

sre-ops: +1 on metric/alert. I'll add a rate alert on ambiguous_lookup > 5/min for production and a silent aggregation for the last 24h.

security-bot: Risk assessment: low-to-medium. No evidence of privilege escalation yet, but ambiguous matching increases blast radius if tenant parsing or normalization logic is subverted. Recommend temporary lock-down of admin roles for ambiguous-service accounts until fix deployed.

kevin (sec-eng): Proposed action plan:
1) Emergency toggle: prefer tenant-qualified username when tenant attr present (hosts only) — short-lived.
2) Add metric + alert for ambiguous_lookup (sre-ops).
3) Patch role-mapper to use subject + tenant precedence and reject global lookups without explicit tenant qualifier.
4) Add KMS-wrapped assertion blob or fingerprint to audit event (maria).
5) Add unit + integration tests for duplicate-localpart cases.

alex (platform): I can own the toggle + hosted rollout (30m runway). Private deploys require a minor upgrade; will draft release note.

jonathan (sre): I'll own the alert and a runbook entry for ambiguous_lookup. Also will add an on-call pager if rate goes above threshold after flip (to catch regressions).

maria (idp): I'll update audit schema and coordinate with kms-team to encrypt assertion blobs before storage. Also add a migration for existing ambiguous events to at least include fingerprint.

kevin (sec-eng): Creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/672 — description: tenant-qualified username precedence + clearer ambiguous logs + unit tests for service-account collisions. Will link deploy plan.

jonathan (sre): After deploy please post a short blameless note to #incidents so we have a trace and timeline.

kevin (sec-eng): Will do. tagging oncall: @oncall-eb for post-deploy validation.

sre-ops: :thumbsup: added alert rule and dashboard panel. Will mute the pager for the first hour during rollout.

alex (platform): Hosted toggle deployed to canary. Observability looks good so far. No regression in auth latency.

kevin (sec-eng): Thanks team — follow-ups: (a) add e2e test with identical localparts across tenants, (b) security review of normalization functions, (c) add audit retention policy for KMS blobs. I'll open follow-up tickets.

security-bot: Noted mitigation steps and created advisory ticket SEC-2023-482.

kevin (sec-eng): Closing thread here, will update #incidents after full prod rollout. "
